anim.credit: Presets from Hyprland Visual Editor (MIT) by XimoCP, Hermy and linux-fertxo.
anim.preset_desc: Curves and timings for windows, fades and workspaces.

banner.adopt: Take over the file (original is kept)
banner.applying: Saving and waiting for Hyprland to reload…
banner.conflict: The file was changed elsewhere and left alone: {reason}
banner.not_effective: Not in effect, probably overridden by a later file: {list}
banner.not_ours: The file was written by hand or edited since the last save.
banner.pending: Keep these changes? Reverting in {s} s.
banner.verifying: Waiting for Hyprland to load the file…

animations.enabled: Turn all animations on or off.

binds.workspace_back_and_forth: Switching to the current workspace goes back to the previous one.

cursor.hide_on_key_press: Hide the cursor on any key press.
cursor.inactive_timeout: Seconds without movement before the cursor hides. 0 is never.

blur.enabled: Blur what is behind translucent windows.
blur.passes: More passes, smoother blur, more GPU time.
blur.size: Blur radius per pass. Costs GPU time.

decoration.dim_strength: How much inactive windows are darkened.
decoration.rounding: Rounded window corners, in layout px.
decoration.rounding_power: 2 is a circle, higher values give squircle corners.

shadow.render_power: Higher values make the shadow fade faster.

general.border_size: Window border thickness. Colors come from your theme.
general.gaps_in: Space between windows, in layout px.
general.gaps_out: Space between windows and the screen edges.
general.resize_on_border: Drag window borders and gaps to resize.

input.accel_profile: How pointer speed grows with movement.
input.follow_mouse: How moving the pointer changes focus.
input.kb_layout: XKB layout, several separated by commas (e.g. de,us).
input.kb_variant: XKB variant, e.g. nodeadkeys. Empty for the default.
input.natural_scroll: Scroll the content, not the view.
input.numlock_by_default: Turn Num Lock on at login.
input.repeat_delay: Milliseconds before a held key repeats.
input.repeat_rate: Repeats per second while a key is held.

touchpad.clickfinger_behavior: 1, 2 or 3 fingers press left, right or middle button.
touchpad.disable_while_typing: Ignore the touchpad while you type.
touchpad.natural_scroll: Scroll the content with two fingers, like on a phone.
touchpad.tap_to_click: A light tap counts as a click.

misc.disable_splash_rendering: Hide the splash text under the logo.
misc.focus_on_activate: Focus apps that ask for attention.
misc.key_press_enables_dpms: A key press turns screens back on.
misc.mouse_move_enables_dpms: Moving the mouse turns screens back on.

xwayland.enabled: Run X11 apps. Off saves memory if every app is native Wayland.
xwayland.force_zero_scaling: X11 apps render at full resolution instead of being upscaled.

disp.last: At least one screen must stay on.
disp.not_row: Your screens are not in one row. The first change here lines them up left to right.
disp.row_hint: Screens are placed left to right in this order, tops aligned.

reason.not_loaded: Hyprland did not load the file. Is it required in hyprland.lua?
reason.restarted: the plugin restarted during the countdown

config_path.description: The Lua file this plugin writes. Load it from hyprland.lua with require("hyprland-settings"). A symlink is followed; the file it points to is replaced.
config_path.label: Config file

setup.ask: Hyprland does not load the settings file yet. Add this line to the end of {conf}? A backup is kept, and the file is created if it is missing.
setup.custom_path: The settings file {file} is outside ~/.config/hypr, so it cannot be loaded by name. Move it there in the plugin settings, or load it yourself.
setup.manual: Until Hyprland loads the file, Apply stays off. To connect it yourself:
setup.no_lua: This system uses hyprland.conf. The plugin needs Hyprland 0.56 or newer with a Lua config.
setup.not_loaded: The line is in place, but Hyprland has not loaded the file. Check hyprctl configerrors.
setup.step2: 2. Add this line to {conf}, after your own settings and before anything that must win over the panel:
setup.step3: 3. Save. Hyprland reloads by itself, then press Check again.
setup.title: Connect Hyprland Settings to Hyprland
setup.working: Setting up and waiting for Hyprland to reload…

ui.gaps_sides: Sides differ: {sides}. The slider sets all four.
ui.legend: Highlighted names are written to your settings file. A dot marks an unsaved change; ↶ undoes it, the eraser takes a value out of the file.
ui.not_effective: Saved {saved}, but Hyprland uses {live}. A later config file probably overrides it.
ui.unavailable: Not known to this Hyprland version
ui.unmanage: Remove from the file: Hyprland uses its default or your other config again
ui.why: Add a reason (written above the value)
